title: AI Unboxing Video Maker | AIVideosUGC
description: Create unboxing videos from one product photo. Show the box, tissue, product and included pieces for TikTok, Shorts, store pages and paid ads.
h1: Create an Unboxing Video from One Product Photo
lead: Show how a package opens and what arrives inside from one product photo. Set the box, tissue, reveal order and final frame for a product page or paid ad.
benefits_h2: Make one product reveal useful across your store

benefits.d: Open on the parcel, move through tissue and finish on the product so shoppers can follow the reveal from first frame to last.

benefits.t: Test another opening from one photo
benefits.d: Change the box, tissue or hand position to try another hook without shipping another sample or booking another shoot.
Place the main item first, then lay out its accessories so product pages and paid ads answer what arrives before checkout.

steps_h2: How to Make Unboxing Videos in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: Go from one clear product photo to an unboxing reveal that fits a product page, social post or paid ad.

steps.d: Start with the product you actually sell and keep its full shape visible. A clear photo gives the reveal a reliable product reference.
Describe the parcel, tissue and one opening action in a short sentence. Name the order shoppers should see: package, main item, then included pieces.
Review the clip beside your product before publishing. Download it for store, social or paid ads, then add final text in an editor.

faq.q: Do I need a photo of the packaging?
faq.a: No. Start with a clear product photo and describe the box, mailer or tissue style you want to show.

faq.q: Can I make a gift set or bundle reveal?
faq.a: Yes. Name the main product and its included pieces, then show the main item before the accessories.

faq.q: What video lengths can I choose?
faq.a: Choose 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds, then use the length that gives the opening and reveal a clear finish.
The supported formats are 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3 and 3:4; choose the frame required by the channel where you will post.

faq.q: Can I use the clip on a product page?
faq.a: Yes. Download the clip, place it with your listing media and follow the store or marketplace media rules.

faq.q: Will logos and printed words render correctly?
faq.a: AI lettering can vary. Review every label and add final brand text in your editor after download.

faq.q: How many credits does an unboxing video use?
faq.a: A 6-second video uses 24 credits, 10 seconds uses 40, 15 seconds uses 60 and 30 seconds uses 120. Failed jobs return credits automatically.

faq.q: Can I use the clip for paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. Check the product, package and accessories first, add campaign text in an editor and follow the platform rules before launch.

cta_lead: Start with a clear product photo, choose the reveal length and review the credit cost before generation.

more_sections.h2: Build a reveal shoppers can follow
more_sections.lead: Plan each beat so the package, main item and included pieces stay clear from opening to final frame.

items.d: Start with the sealed mailer or box, then make the opening action easy to see.
Keep the flap, hands and product path in frame as tissue moves aside.
Bring the product into view before smaller extras so shoppers know what they are considering.
Place each included piece beside the main item so the set is easy to understand.
End with the product centered and unobstructed so shoppers can inspect its shape and finish.
Keep the box and product centered when the reveal is intended for a vertical social feed.
Ship a sample, book a crew and wait for edits before one reveal is ready.
Start with one product photo, set the reveal and try another opening without a new shoot.

actor_scene_picker.title: Choose an avatar and reveal scene
actor_scene_picker.lead: Pick a presenter and setting for the opening, then carry the reveal direction into your video.

steps.sourceAlt: Your product: a plain candle jar shown upright with its full shape visible.
steps.prompt: Use the uploaded product photo as the exact product reference. Keep its shape and color unchanged. Adult hands open a plain shipping box, fold back tissue and lift the product toward the camera, ending with the item centered and steady. Warm natural light, realistic handheld product-video look. Sound: box and tissue movement; no text, logos or music.
